node.title: Re: sendmail - worried illegal chars
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [hankcoder],

I'd recommend you leave the work of creating and sending an email to a module. [mod://Email::Sender] (with [mod://Email::Simple]) is just one of many. Something like this (based on [mod://Email::Sender::Manual::QuickStart]):

use warnings; use strict; use Email::Sender::Simple qw/sendmail/; use Email::Simple; my $email = Email::Simple->create( header => [ To => '"Xavier Q. Ample" ', From => '"Bob Fishman" ', Subject => "don't forget to *enjoy the sauce*", ], body => "This message is short, but at least it's cheap.\n", ); print $email->as_string; # debug sendmail($email);

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
